		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (

) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from

where business_date = '2025-06-16' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from

where business_date = '2025-06-16' and analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
) as c on var.run_id = c.run_id and c.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and c.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and c.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(

	WHERE

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,

    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records

    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *

    union all

),

    where is_alert = 'Y'

            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )

),

    union all

)

/* cppi::fc7a3500caf9d4ae3e1b7c04bd01651c0f1af0105e77c1181ecd31b11e47e163 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-08')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-08')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-08')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

WITH 
	cred_exp_by_country AS
	  (
		SELECT
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
		  parent.sovr_country_rating AS rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook AS outlook,
		  GREATEST(0, SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(fact.credit_exposure, 0) ELSE 0 END )) AS tot_exposure,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit AS tot_limit,
		  MAX( parent.region_fi_limit ) AS region_fi_limit
		FROM radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact 
		JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_country ref_country ON ref_country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = ref_country.alpha_2_code
		WHERE
		  fact.business_date='2025-06-17'
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          and fact.business_date = ref_country.business_date
		  AND parent.sovr_fi_limit IS NOT NULL
		  AND ( parent.IS_FI IS NOT NULL OR child.IS_FI IS NOT NULL )
		  AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
		GROUP BY
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code),
		  parent.sovr_country_rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit
	  )

	SELECT *
	FROM
	  (
		SELECT
		  country,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN 'OK'
		    WHEN (tot_exposure / COALESCE(GREATEST(tot_limit, 1), 1)) > 1 THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  rating,
		  outlook,
		  tot_exposure/1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN -1
			WHEN tot_limit = 0 THEN 0
			ELSE tot_limit / 1000000
		  END AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN '-'
			WHEN tot_exposure > tot_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE format('%,.0f', truncate( ( tot_limit - GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure ) ) / 1000000))
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 OR tot_limit = 0 OR tot_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure / tot_limit * 100), 1)
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
		  'Eurozone' AS country,
		  CASE
		    WHEN SUM( COALESCE( tot_exposure, 0 ) ) > region_fi_limit THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  '' AS rating,
		  '' AS outlook,
		  SUM( tot_exposure ) / 1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  COALESCE( region_fi_limit / 1000000, 0 ) AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN SUM( tot_exposure ) > region_fi_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( region_fi_limit - GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN region_fi_limit = 0 OR region_fi_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) / region_fi_limit * 100 ), 1 )
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		WHERE country IN ( 'France', 'Germany', 'Netherlands', 'Spain' )
		GROUP BY region_fi_limit
      ) c
    WHERE c.status <> 'OK'
	ORDER BY
	  CASE WHEN country = 'Eurozone' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	  tot_exposure DESC

                            CASE si.market_sector_desc
                                WHEN 'Pfd' THEN CONCAT(si.ticker, ' Pfd')
                                WHEN 'Equity' THEN CONCAT(eu.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange, ' Equity')

        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id

    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),

    select *

    union all
    select *

            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,

    union all

WITH prev_business_date AS
         (
             SELECT
                 max(fact.business_date) as business_date
             FROM radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date < '2025-06-17'
         ),
	current_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      parent.party_name,
	      parent.cppib_party_id,
	      parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      COALESCE( country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS country_code,
	      parent.rtg_final AS rtg_final,
	      parent.rtg_outlook AS rtg_outlook,

	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
		  MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	    FROM
	      radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	      radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	      radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
	      radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_country country ON country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = country.alpha_2_code
	    WHERE
	      fact.business_date = '2025-06-17'
		  and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	      AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	      AND
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
				    parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
	    GROUP BY
	      parent.party_name,
	      parent.cppib_party_id,
	      parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      COALESCE( country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
	      parent.rtg_final,
	      parent.rtg_outlook
	  ),
		prev_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      parent.party_name,
		  parent.cppib_party_id,
	      parent.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_st_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_mt_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_lt_exposure
	    FROM
	      prev_business_date p
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
		    ON child.business_date = p.business_date
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
		    ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		    ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
		    ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'
	    WHERE
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
				    parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
		GROUP BY
	      parent.cppib_party_id,
	      parent.party_name,
	      parent.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	      FROM
	        radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
	      WHERE
		    fact.business_date = '2025-06-17'
		    and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	                WHERE
					  parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
	                  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
            WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	        WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	        WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	        WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		    ELSE COALESCE( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,  
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  COALESCE( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  COALESCE( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	 SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c
	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      COALESCE(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
	  CASE
	    WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
	    ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
	  END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c
	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH MaxBusinessDates AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten) AS max_ist_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_seclvl) AS max_psl_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite) AS max_secc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_pcc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) AS max_scds_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_party_issuer) AS max_spi_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_epc_bd
        
)
SELECT
    psl.business_date,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel3 as investment_structure_level_03,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel4 as investment_structure_level_04 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel5 as investment_structure_level_05 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel6 as investment_structure_level_06 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel7 as investment_structure_level_07 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel8 as investment_structure_level_08 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel9 as investment_structure_level_09 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel10 as investment_structure_level_10 ,
    ist.model_portfolio_name, 
    psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_2 as quoted_currency,
    psl.aggregation_level_3 as scd_security_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_4,
    psl.aggregation_level_5,
    secc.esm_security_name,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency,
    psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency, 
    psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency, 
    psl.market_value_reporting_currency, 
    psl.market_value_quotation_currency,
    coalesce (pcc.epm_party_name, epc.epm_party_name) as issuer,
    upcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent
FROM 
    performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
LEFT JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist
    ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = ist.model_portfolio
    AND ist.business_date = (select max_ist_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
    AND ist.investmentstructure IN ('CPPIB_F24')
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities scds
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = scds.abor_security_id
    AND scds.business_date = (select max_scds_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
	on scds.abor_issuer_id = spi.party_id
	and spi.business_date = (select max_spi_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite epc
	on epc.party_id = spi.party_id 
	and epc.business_date = (select max_epc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
LEFT JOIN cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = secc.abor_security_id
    AND secc.business_date = (select max_secc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
	and pcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite upcc
	on coalesce (pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id, epc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id) = upcc.enterprise_party_id
	and upcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
WHERE 
    psl.business_date > '2025-03-31' ) ds LIMIT 0

/* cppi::c0eaa3e86045bf1c06efc8bbd1b268cccee71a6d69df3c7ba6c13ee242e3ece9 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 00 and 01
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 00:10:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
